metadata.name: walletNote
metadata.description: wallet status line, written by the wallet handlers. put =walletNote in a cell for a reactive readout.

metadata.name: wallet.newName
metadata.description: name buffer for the wallet() panel's add-a-key row (names aren't secret). cleared after a key is stored.

metadata.name: wallet
metadata.description: (trigger?) - a reactive, self-contained wallet UI. =wallet(walletNote) shows 🔒 locked + the unlock box, or 🔓 unlocked + the key names + a lock button + an add-a-key row (name + secret). Re-renders on every lock/unlock/set.

metadata.name: locked
metadata.description: (trigger?) - the lock state as a BOOLEAN (true=locked). =locked(walletNote) to track it reactively.

metadata.name: editKey
metadata.description: (lockCell, name) - per-key edit + delete in one cell. Pass the lock cell (=wallet() or =locked(walletNote)) first so this cell reacts to lock/unlock. Locked → cannot edit; unlocked → a secret box to set/update + a ✕ delete. =editKey(A1, "anthropic").

metadata.name: walletKeys
metadata.description: (trigger?) - GENESIS: one ROW per stored key in a keys worksheet — col A = the live handle (🔑 name, referenceable: =claude(chat!A1, keys!A1)), col B = a ✕ delete button. Pass walletNote so it regenerates as keys change.

metadata.name: unlockWallet
metadata.description: () - a password input that unlocks the wallet (creates it on first use). the password never touches a cel or formula. status: =walletNote.

metadata.name: setKey
metadata.description: (name [, trigger]) - a password box that stores a secret under name. Pass walletNote as the trigger so the box appears once unlocked: =setKey("anthropic", walletNote). The secret never touches a cel or formula source.

metadata.name: apiKey
metadata.description: (name) - a resolver HANDLE for a stored secret, not the secret. pass to api fns: =claude(chat!A1, apiKey("anthropic")). saves/seeds/ranges only ever carry the name.

metadata.name: apiKeys
metadata.description: () - the stored key NAMES (never values), one per line.

metadata.name: lockWallet
metadata.description: () - a 🔒 lock button; locks the wallet ON CLICK (forgets keys; encrypted file stays). =wallet(walletNote) shows this when unlocked.

metadata.name: exportWallet
metadata.description: () - a button that downloads the ENCRYPTED wallet file (safe to move between machines).

metadata.name: importWallet
metadata.description: () - a file input that installs an exported wallet file, then =unlockWallet() opens it.

metadata.name: wallet.unlock
metadata.description: dispatch handler for unlockWallet's input — derives the master key, decrypts /plastron/wallet.json (or creates it).

metadata.name: wallet.set
metadata.description: dispatch handler for setKey's input — stores the secret and re-encrypts the wallet file.

metadata.name: wallet.setNamed
metadata.description: dispatch handler for the panel's add-a-key secret field — reads the name from wallet.newName + the secret from the event, stores + re-encrypts.

metadata.name: wallet.lock
metadata.description: dispatch handler for the lock button — forgets the unlocked keys (the encrypted file stays).

metadata.name: wallet.del
metadata.description: dispatch handler for a per-key ✕ delete button (payload = key name) — removes the key and re-encrypts.

metadata.name: wallet.export
metadata.description: dispatch handler for exportWallet's button — downloads the encrypted file as wallet.json.

metadata.name: wallet.import
metadata.description: dispatch handler for importWallet's file input — writes the picked file to /plastron/wallet.json (locked until unlocked).
